12 1/4 hole The pore pressure is expected to be normal, except for possible slight increase through the Cretaceous formation. On previous wells on the 15/9 block, tight hole has been experienced down to 0 in. These problems seem to be caused by swelling clays and possibly differential sticking. To reduce the problems, mud weight should be kept at at minimum and a thin filter cake maintained. The hole
